We need an ETA for mitigation steps and any temporary credits given the impact.

— Arianna

On it — quick findings from the reserved pool (pool-id: rsv-az1-013):
- GPU utilization: sustained 94–99% across 4 cards for last 22 minutes.
- Queue depth: median 65 requests, 95th 210 requests queued; request processing time stretched due to long seq-lengths (~2k) and attention compute blowups.
- Top consumer by open sockets: DT-48321 (Aurora) ~71% of pool throughput.

Proposed immediate mitigations (can be applied without model upload):
1) Enable per-customer max-batch-size=4 and max-prefetch=8 for DT-48321 to reduce queue serialization.
2) Flip routing to quantized-llama-7b-q4o (compatible checkpoint) — I ran a dry compatibility check, should be OK for current prompt shapes.
3) Apply per-request token cap of 256 and set abort-on-timeout=2000ms.
4) If burst capacity is available, route 30% of ingress to hosted pool for next 2 hours.

I'll attach the snippet from the runbook that lists the exact CLI commands. We should schedule an ops bridge to implement steps 1–3 now.

Attachment: mitigation_runbook_v2.pdf

— Irene
